text_block_list.text:
When I headed to the cafeteria for 
lunch... For some reason, there was a 
horse girl staring intently at the other 
students eating.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Staaaaaare...)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...I am conducting observational training.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Just by observing how everyone eats, 
one can glean their various perspectives 
and insights. For instance—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well well, Creek, having cake again? Ain't 
you lacking a bit of self-control there?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Well, I thought it'd be fine since it's 
lunchtime... Sweets are nourishment for 
the soul, after all~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
More importantly Inari-chan, isn't that 
way less than what you usually eat? Are 
you okay? You ordered a small portion of 
soba, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I-It's fine! Soba's meant to be slurped 
down quick and easy, that's what makes it 
stylish!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... For those who compete on the 
track, everyday nutrition is also a 
crucial form of discipline.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, each individual possesses their 
own philosophy. My goal is to learn and 
absorb them.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Back at the dojo, observing and learning 
from the training of senior disciples was 
second nature to me.
choice_data_list: By the way, what do you prioritize?
By the way, what do you value most?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Nutritional balance above all else. I make 
a conscious effort not to accustom myself 
to luxury or extravagant delicacies.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
However, others must have their own 
reasoning. The more exceptional the horse 
girl, the firmer their conviction...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ngh!?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Phew... I'm hungry.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Oguri-san... One of the foremost runners 
among us. I must observe closely what she 
selects.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I can't decide what to get.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Alright. For starters, the mackerel 
simmered in miso set meal.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the same menu as mine. Mackerel is 
rich in nutrients, so Oguri-san also 
values nutriti—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Make that ten servings.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Also, hamburger steaks are an absolute 
must. Give me five plates of that. Five 
extra-large katsudon bowls as well. Oh, 
they have onigiri too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
In that case, pickles would make a fine 
accompaniment... Having only katsudon 
feels a bit lonely on fried food though, 
what else... Right, let's go with fried 
chicken.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I-I cannot decipher it! Ordering that 
much... what on earth is Oguri-san aiming 
for...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: *gasp*... Could it be!?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Does Oguri-san view eating... as training 
to test and ascertain the absolute limits 
of her own body!?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If so, that tremendous order makes total 
sense! Ah... had I been underestimating 
the art of dining all along...!?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I cannot afford to lose! I too shall 
follow Oguri-san's example and order more!
choice_data_list:
A portion suited to oneself might be 
better...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Osu! Then without further ado, I shall go 
place my order!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, challenge requested! Five 
servings of tatsuta-age and three ginger 
pork sets, please!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hmm, ordering more as well, Yaeno?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Oguri-san... Thanks to you, my eyes have 
been opened.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I, Yaeno Muteki, refuse to lag behind 
anyone, even in the arena of digestion! 
Come, let us clash fair and square!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Huh? Fair and square...? Ginger sauté...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Ginger sauté with soy sauce. *drool*... 
Maybe I should order ginger pork too...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ah!? That's right... I had already 
assembled my meal based on my own 
deliberate reasoning...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Wavering in one's convictions will never 
lead to mastery in martial arts... I came 
perilously close to straying from the path 
and losing myself.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Mmh... Even so.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Now then... time for dessert.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Donuts, cheese tarts, crepes... and maybe 
some fruit for a refreshing touch—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
How terrifying, to rattle my very spirit 
through mere food alone, Oguri-san... I 
still have much to learn...
